attr.title: Slopetanium
attr.desc: Updater for PortMaster ports published as GitHub releases. Watch repos from a browser on your PC, phone or tablet, get told about new releases, update or roll back with one press, and delete the original game files a port has already imported.
attr.inst: Copy Slopetanium.sh into your Ports folder and slopetanium into ports, or install the zip with PortMaster. Start it, then open the address shown on screen in a browser on the same network and enter the PIN.
